verdict.rationale: gstack ships its skills as SKILL.md folders (review/, qa/, ship/, and others) and supports many agent hosts beyond Claude Code, including Codex, Cursor, Kiro, OpenCode, Copilot and Antigravity. However, it reaches those hosts through per-host TypeScript configs and a generator, plus a compressed AGENTS digest for hosts without a full skill install. That suggests per-host output rather than one spec-valid folder reused unchanged, and nothing in the evidence explicitly claims conformance to the open Agent Skills specification. Missing for 10: an explicit statement of Agent Skills spec conformance, evidence that the same skill folder works unmodified across vendors, and independent validation of portability.
